description: Complete SO-101 six-capability and Go2 five-capability authoring references. These are examples, never selectable hidden cases.

worked_references.description: Complete worked reference: capability contracts, one nominal and one calibrated-boundary request per capability, semantic trusted inline measurement operators, exact criteria, scenes, and guards. It contains no task_support relation or task execution plan.

reference_source.specific_reference: Experiment 1 B1 Driver Validation Criteria, SO-101 A1-A6 and fixed capability bundle

capabilities.description: Move the SO-101 end effector to one bounded world-frame position.
preconditions: The public robot state is available and finite before motion starts.
The requested world-frame target and duration satisfy the closed request schema.

temporal_semantics.completion: Regulate until the terminal hold criterion is satisfied or the requested duration expires.

invariants: Commands remain within the public actuator and joint limits.
The gripper aperture is not intentionally changed while the arm target is regulated.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Stop active motion and return a bounded capability error when the request cannot be completed within its declared duration or public limits.

source_refs.specific_reference: SO-101 A1: position error <= 0.015 m continuously for 0.5 s

capabilities.description: Trace bounded SO-101 world-frame Cartesian waypoints in order.
capabilities.effect: Ordered Cartesian path tracking with bounded cross-track error.
preconditions: The public robot state is available and finite before path execution starts.
Every requested world-frame waypoint and segment duration satisfies the closed request schema.

temporal_semantics.completion: Visit the supplied waypoints in order, then maintain the terminal waypoint for the criterion-defined hold.

invariants: Waypoint order is preserved throughout the call.
Commands remain within the public actuator and joint limits.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Stop active path motion and return a bounded capability error if a waypoint cannot be reached in sequence within the declared segment durations or public limits.

source_refs.specific_reference: SO-101 A2: ordered waypoints, cross-track <= 0.020 m, final error <= 0.015 m for 0.5 s

capabilities.description: Set the SO-101 physical gripper aperture by normalised opening fraction.
capabilities.effect: Bounded gripper aperture regulation without changing the arm target.
preconditions: The public gripper state is available and finite before aperture regulation starts.
The requested opening fraction and duration satisfy the closed request schema.

temporal_semantics.completion: Regulate the aperture until the criterion-defined hold is satisfied or the requested duration expires.

invariants: The active arm pose target is not intentionally changed by this call.
Gripper commands remain within the public actuator limits.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Stop changing the gripper command and return a bounded capability error if the requested aperture cannot be established within the declared duration or public limits.

source_refs.specific_reference: SO-101 A3: aperture error <= 0.10 for 0.25 s and excursion >= 50%

capabilities.description: Approach a reachable target along a bounded ray until controlled contact.
capabilities.effect: Bounded axial approach with controlled target contact and penetration.
preconditions: The public robot and contact observations are available and finite before approach starts.
The precontact pose, approach direction, travel, speed, and duration satisfy the closed request schema.

temporal_semantics.completion: Reach the precontact state, advance along the declared ray, and stop advancing once controlled contact is established.

invariants: Motion proceeds along the declared approach direction after the precontact state.
Commands remain within the requested travel, speed, public actuator, and joint limits.
Unrelated contact is not intentionally created.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Stop the approach and return a bounded capability error on unavailable contact observations, unrelated contact, exhausted travel or duration, or a public-limit violation.

source_refs.specific_reference: SO-101 A4: contact 0.1 s, post-contact speed <= 0.02 m/s, penetration <= 0.005 m, unrelated contacts 0

capabilities.description: Move the SO-101 end effector by a base-frame offset and return.
capabilities.effect: Ordered outbound and return displacement tracking in the robot-base frame.
preconditions: The public robot state is available and finite before the outbound leg starts.
The requested robot-base offset and per-leg duration satisfy the closed request schema.

temporal_semantics.completion: Establish the requested outbound displacement before returning to the captured start pose.

invariants: The call uses the robot-base frame captured at its start.
The return leg is not started before the outbound leg has completed.
Commands remain within the public actuator and joint limits.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Stop active motion and return a bounded capability error if either ordered leg cannot complete within its declared duration or public limits.

source_refs.specific_reference: SO-101 A5: outbound/return errors <= 0.015 m and displacement >= 80%

capabilities.description: Set the SO-101 wrist-roll joint to one bounded absolute angle while holding the other joints.
capabilities.effect: Absolute non-wrapped wrist-roll regulation with whole-arm hold.
preconditions: The public arm and gripper joint state is available and finite before wrist regulation starts.
The requested absolute wrist-roll angle and duration satisfy the closed request schema.

temporal_semantics.completion: Regulate the non-wrapped wrist-roll target until the criterion-defined hold is satisfied or the requested duration expires.

invariants: All non-wrist arm joints and the gripper retain their captured targets.
Commands remain within the public actuator and joint limits.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Stop changing the wrist target and return a bounded capability error if the requested angle cannot be held within the declared duration or public limits.

source_refs.specific_reference: SO-101 A6: wrist-roll error <= 0.03 rad and all other arm joints/gripper held

reference_source.specific_reference: Experiment 1 B1 Driver Validation Criteria, Unitree Go2 G1-G5 and fixed capability bundle

capabilities.description: Track a bounded planar body-frame twist for a fixed duration.
capabilities.effect: Planar body-frame velocity and yaw-rate tracking.
preconditions: The public base state is available and finite before twist tracking starts.
The requested body-frame velocity, yaw rate, and duration satisfy the closed request schema.

temporal_semantics.completion: Track the requested twist for the declared duration and evaluate the criterion-defined terminal window.

invariants: The commanded planar velocity remains expressed in the current body frame.
Actuator commands remain within the public control limits while maintaining support integrity.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Stop the commanded twist and return a bounded capability error if public state becomes unavailable or support integrity cannot be maintained within public limits.

source_refs.specific_reference: Go2 G1: final-window mean planar velocity error <= 0.10 m/s and yaw-rate error <= 0.30 rad/s

capabilities.description: Move the Go2 base to a pose relative to its initial yaw frame.
capabilities.effect: Planar relative-pose regulation with terminal settling.
preconditions: The public base state is available and finite so the initial position and yaw can be captured.
The requested relative translation, yaw change, and duration satisfy the closed request schema.

temporal_semantics.completion: Regulate the pose relative to the initial-yaw frame, then maintain the terminal state for the criterion-defined hold.

invariants: The initial-yaw reference captured at call start remains fixed throughout the call.
Actuator commands remain within the public control limits while maintaining support integrity.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Stop planar motion and return a bounded capability error if the relative pose cannot be settled within the declared duration or support and public limits cannot be maintained.

source_refs.specific_reference: Go2 G2: position error <= 0.10 m, yaw error <= 0.0873 rad, speed <= 0.10 m/s for 0.5 s

capabilities.description: Trace bounded planar waypoints in the initial-yaw frame.
capabilities.effect: Ordered planar waypoint and cross-track path following.
preconditions: The public base state is available and finite so the initial-yaw frame can be captured.
Every requested planar waypoint and the duration satisfy the closed request schema.

temporal_semantics.completion: Visit the supplied waypoints in order in the captured initial-yaw frame, then settle at the endpoint.

invariants: Waypoint order and the initial-yaw frame captured at call start remain fixed throughout the call.
Actuator commands remain within the public control limits while maintaining support integrity.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Stop planar motion and return a bounded capability error if a waypoint cannot be visited in order within the declared duration or support and public limits cannot be maintained.

source_refs.specific_reference: Go2 G3: waypoint error <= 0.10 m, cross-track <= 0.15 m, endpoint error/speed <= 0.10

capabilities.description: Set Go2 body height while retaining a stable local stance.
capabilities.effect: Body-height regulation with bounded attitude and planar drift.
preconditions: The public base and attitude state is available and finite before height regulation starts.
The requested body height and duration satisfy the closed request schema.

temporal_semantics.completion: Regulate body height while retaining the local stance, then maintain the terminal state for the criterion-defined hold.

invariants: The local planar pose and yaw captured at call start are retained except for bounded stabilization motion.
Actuator commands remain within the public control limits while maintaining support integrity.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Stop changing the height target and return a bounded capability error if height cannot be settled within the declared duration or attitude, support, and public limits cannot be maintained.

source_refs.specific_reference: Go2 G4: height <= 0.03 m, roll/pitch <= 0.1745 rad, displacement <= 0.05 m, yaw drift <= 0.0873 rad

capabilities.description: Recover from one Framework reset disturbance and hold stable stance.
capabilities.effect: Post-disturbance quadruped stabilization with support integrity.
preconditions: The declared disturbance has been applied and the public base, attitude, velocity, and contact state is available and finite.
The requested stabilization duration satisfies the closed request schema.

temporal_semantics.completion: Recover a supported stance, then maintain it for the requested duration under the structured criterion.

invariants: Support contacts are retained or recovered without intentionally creating forbidden contacts.
Actuator commands remain within the public control limits while stabilizing the base.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Stop recovery motion and return a bounded capability error if a supported stance cannot be recovered or public state and control limits cannot be maintained.
